name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/5/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
---
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Happy Super Tuesday! Today marks Super Tuesday, a pivotal moment in the presidential primary season. Colorado, alongside 15 other states and one territory, will play a crucial role in shaping the trajectory of the race. With more ballots cast today than all previous primaries combined, the stakes are high. Coloradans have until 7 p.m. to vote in person or drop off their mail-in ballots. While the presidential primaries dominate the headlines, Colorado's unique primary system allows unaffiliated voters to participate in either party's primary, but they must choose one. Notably, the Colorado Democratic Primary features the 'Noncommitted delegate' option, raising questions about voter sentiment towards President Biden. On the Republican side, former U.S. Ambassador Nikki Haley poses a challenge to former President Trump, with Colorado's open primary potentially offering her a foothold. With results expected shortly after polls close, we'll watch closely and update you LIVE on [RockyMountainVoice.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, March 5, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Colorado primary turnout at 30.5% as of mid-Election Day report**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
Election Day voting pushed turnout above 30.5% Tuesday and Republican Party primary ballots past 600,000, an 11 a.m. report from the secretary of state’s office detailed. There have been 1,155,302 ballots cast among 3,786,720 registered voters, with 59.1% of returned and counted ballots being voted in the Republican Party’s primary election. Ballots cast in the Democratic Party’s primary election trails by 18.3%, with 140,272 ballots in process. Unaffiliated voters have cast about 37.9% of all ballots in the primary election, with those voters casting 438,399 ballots. Almost half of the unaffiliated ballots cast – 204,172 – have been cast in the Republican Party’s primary, with 94,037 cast in the Democratic Party’s primary.
| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Secretary Griswold: ‘Election night results are not final results’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* “Election night results are not final results in Colorado,” Griswold said. “After Election Day, ballots continue to be counted, military and oversees voters return their ballots, signature discrepancies can be fixed, and bipartisan audits are conducted to confirm the results – there is quite a bit of activity that occurs after Election Day across the state.”

* Initial results are not reported within the state until polls close across the state. After polls close at 7 p.m., counties begin to upload results to the state’s centralized Election Night Reporting system, Griswold said, and results will be available at GoVoteColorado.gov.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Elon Musk criticizes program that flew 320,000 ‘unvetted’ illegal immigrants into America**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Elon Musk criticized President Biden's administration for flying 320,000 "unvetted" migrants into the US, warning that it could lead to a national security threat worse than 9/11. Musk argued that this influx of migrants not only poses a security risk but also serves as a tactic to import voters, linking it to the ongoing debate over voter ID requirements.

* The process, facilitated through the Customs and Border Patrol app (CBP One), allows migrants to fly into 43 American airports without public disclosure of their origin, raising legal and security concerns.

* Musk, known for his outspokenness against Biden's border policies, previously visited the southern border in Texas, where he expressed alarm over the situation and warned of potential future consequences, including strain on social services and housing shortages in major cities like New York.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Sonnenberg wins 4th District straw poll in Holyoke, his second straw poll victory**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jerry Sonnenberg emerges as a contender for CD4 race following his second straw poll win at a tri-county forum in Holyoke.

* Sonnenberg secured 29.9% of the vote, surpassing opponents Ted Harvey and Lauren Boebert, reflecting strong support from the Eastern Plains residents for a homegrown candidate.

* Organized by Phillips County Republican Party Chairman Steven Brown, the event aimed to engage voters from rural areas, highlighting the significance of grassroots involvement in the political process. Brown emphasizes that this current straw poll is important to gauge candidate perception among voters within the participating counties of Phillips, Sedgwick, and Yuma.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**It’s unanimous, Colorado cannot disqualify Trump from ballot**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Supreme Court delivered a landmark victory for former President Trump by unanimously ruling that Colorado cannot disqualify him from the ballot under the 14th Amendment's insurrection ban, preserving his ability to seek a second presidential term.

* This decision effectively ends efforts to prevent Trump from returning to the White House, giving him a significant legal win just ahead of Super Tuesday, where he is expected to secure the Republican nomination.

* While all nine justices sided with Trump, the court's liberal and conservative justices criticized the majority for delving into novel constitutional questions, urging judicial restraint in politically charged cases.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---

Election Day is today, March 5._ **[Frisch commits to support Joe Biden in Democratic forum](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | NATIONAL | MARCH 1** _Adam Frisch, unopposed in his second primary run as a Democrat in Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District, has flipped on his previous position to let the “presidential race play out and see what happens.”_ [**A Beacon of Hope: Dr. Ben Carson’s Message of Optimism for America**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY TORI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | FEB 29** _In the newest episode of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl, Dr. Ben Carson, renowned neurosurgeon, former Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, and steadfast advocate for American values, joined the conversation to set the record straight on his hope for the future of America._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. # 📆 DID YOU KNOW?

Super Tuesday is the United States presidential primary election day in February or March when the greatest number of U.S. states hold primary elections and caucuses. Approximately **one-third of all delegates** to the presidential nominating conventions can be won on Super Tuesday, more than on any other day.

Hi there - just texting a quick message from my phone.
We’re only hours away from polls closing here in California, and we’re doing absolutely everything we can to finish strong.
There are a number of critical swing seats and races that are still too close to call, and our organizers are doing everything they can to get out the vote.
If you haven’t already, would you make a donation to our Election Day Rapid Response Fund so that we have the cash on hand to give our organizers anything and everything they need in the remaining hours?
I’m dropping the link below and keeping a close tab on our budget to ensure we don’t go into the red. Your generous support will greatly help:

- Yvette

Yvette Martinez

Derek, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign for the U.S. Senate in Arizona last year, I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that, it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.
**But it’s more than me. We need to defeat MAGA extremism across the country. We need to protect — and expand — the Democratic Senate majority and elect leaders who will abolish the filibuster and help deliver results for hard-working families. People like Adam Schiff.**
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.

## You see it, you feel it, you know something is not right with our great Republic...
and you're not wrong. Our mutual destruction is all but guaranteed by our current national leadership. We are daily seeing horrific glimpses of our economic and sovereign trajectory play out. When will we wake up as a nation and realize that electing the same old politicians over and over again and expecting different results, is the true definition of insanity.
It is impossible to trust those who are bought and paid for by the special interest who run D.C.. One needs look no further than campaign donations to see just what extent a politician has been co-opted. There's a reason politicians like Mississippi Senator Roger Wicker have been able to remain in power and a part of the D.C. swamp for going on 30 years now. When one does the bidding of special interest donors, those donors reward these individuals with more funds than any potential challenger could ever hope to raise. With money comes the power, the power to shape the narrative and offer a spin to any truth. Doesn't matter if you vote with the Democrats more than almost any other Senate Republican. Doesn't matter if you have one of the lowest collective conservative ratings from all conservative groups. Doesn't matter if you put America last and push hundreds of billions of American taxpayer dollars to fund foreign border wars around the world (while leaving your own border wide open). Doesn't matter that you actually fought President Trump on securing the border. What does matter is that you are one of the largest military industrial complexes' recipients of special interest dollars. You've now got the money now to tell the voters over and over again how altruistic, conservative, and tough on the border you are. You've got the money to tell people its all about national security, as your donors continue to rake in billions of dollars in profits. You can drop $5 million dollars in a primary race in a small state like Mississippi, and think nothing of it. Tell them enough times, they'll all start to believe the spin.
Hope is not lost though, but it will be if we don't collectively break away from the statis quo and stand up to this system. People are starting to wake up. Every Mississippian, and every American, has the power to send a message to the entire ruling class of political elites and tell them "This has to stop!" Your sphere of influence, and the spheres of those you influence, is how grassroots is born.
I will never be owned by special interest. I am running this campaign on my own donations and those of my friends, family, and fellow patriots. I am the only verified proven conservative fighter in this race. I've signed a Term Limits pledge. I haven't sold Mississippi out in my last 8+ years of legislative service, and I won't sell you out when you send me to Washington D.C. to fight for you. Now I need you to help fight for me.
Please watch the video, and share with your sphere. Together we can make a difference, together we can save our great Republic for our children and future generations.
For God and Country,
Dan

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z56s44gkkna6d3ne8s18dq3okt3uvo9k7vubgq1o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o72cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt6hd8i07c7lrebbavdo64cipd0of13ass3kei98_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o72cjh2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8uoud2afd5miuob4o7ai6a59c9oirm69hne0b50_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o72cjh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd0u73hffdpe1ie8ljvbqqbhh7356gus2glm18po_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o72cjh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via Pro Life Update
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb61gqq7c2o5nsdu4vgsin0ncssp1i35gp1nu930_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o71cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z691a8jrv77c5hfeoiethfqt7d46el0jvcd2jci8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o71cth2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgoqndd3dhsvku8j6305c09igm8o9jit69sqo78o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64o71cth2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: What is the Great Reset?
body:

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that's not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcu1lhft439sgcdv9ifkvlqff6tcvock8mcbkp60_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64p70c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6gnfnt6dlto3km2m9a9eauedpirlgus2khmpvho_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64p70c3h2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4t7estf4b6j549caqdh4viihm8chnb7j2623180_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64p70c3h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsudmqgi75c2nasfjjmj2tij6tjr3bt88jvqn40o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth64p70c3h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Your America
subject: Consider...
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30303%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VKM0X6K5QSspoo6ZlyN6JA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30304%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yWXv6pRWheMrdkzlH0WZ%2fw&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30304%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yWXv6pRWheMrdkzlH0WZ%2fw&sysid=1) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlcio8mlm0tf1l3q343v6oe6org1klnagan965qg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth66ob4clh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zodp2t8qhn84m873q93vlblh4qim5mrnj54djtc0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth66ob4clh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8cm5bapn7f67qr8m72d0f32af5nn0l6c0ut28jg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth66ob4clh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z33eet2s12cjf5pia263inda5hr7dmtgmefg0puo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34sth66ob4clh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Arizona’s Senate campaign is going to be a head-to-head between Ruben Gallego and Kari Lake. And we’ve got some good news, and some bad news. **The good news** is that we’ve built an incredible campaign so far. We’ve got close to 150,000 individual donors, and we’ve raised enough to be really competitive this year. **The bad news** is that this campaign is about to get a lot more complicated — and expensive. We’re expecting millions of dollars in attack ads to start coming our way any day now. More than $230 million was spent in Arizona’s Senate campaign in 2022, and we expect this one to be just as expensive. **What that means is that we need a huge surge of donations from folks who have been on the sidelines so far to stay competitive. We need you to make a donation today.** Our average contribution is about $24. Some give more, many give less. Today, the most important thing is that you make that donation. subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/84ceIR0pP_W-sX5SzJHdBw~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/84ceIR0pP_W-sX5SzJHdBw~~/AARclAA~~)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/84ceIR0pP_W-sX5SzJHdBw~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/84ceIR0pP_W-sX5SzJHdBw~~/AARclAA~~).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

## Super Tuesday Results Roll In
Voters went to the polls in fifteen states yesterday for primary voting. The headline result was Former President Trump [winning fourteen states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHu2yAQgPGngY0IH9jYA0MXb-na0SLcOVyCwbJJorx91c7_-Rs-6ffnulwDZy7332Ej39a6hNj4TYtRgwK7WIl-JQIyknzn9ORM74yVyUOc4tiHMBjTrSai1hqnMYzdiCtgD5I9aLDa6KHT_dBNF21xnHqLE3Vwi2CE1YTc6nF5VC4t0Zq_9U3HJdZNZp9a209hfgmYBcwtUeKc_zUBc6obFfqcAuYYtj3wvQiYba8dOKfO106Hai86MXwV1hIyqna8tl09KqkbIxVV-PlklUKmr4BZHh73D-fM5-CE1fct8P-ZbD-p_A0AAP__t7tjkw) (Haley took Vermont) and nearly clenching the GOP presidential nomination. Haley didn't seriously threaten Trump in any other states, and [many expect](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7ojWC8amoPiadPnaKy0wS7wX_CPAifL2p1x95Wia0XzdppvjxNv9v1vJ1rhPbq78pEkKLVBNqg02EiHJlmw3gBlkP0jVLrbXkUwEZ7z2CGTCbMZh7AB10D6Sb9kioAIJuoNed-YCKoymV8FQh35G2SigwHXPl--dt7pQTO_9Sfky72ub7FLrURr5r8Frg1d3bPQqH_WBXHlO1OB148eDxeISvUWm4_SJZ7eJms_1EOU8KIt6UgnuLdJeChVheud77fXoRqLofQRF0UDECEARTZttOF6cEhc9NAruq-P0m1T_-vMTAAD__4PfZ6w) her to drop out of the race. ## Sinema to Leave the Senate
Arizona Senator [Kyrsten Sinema announced](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyrCAUgOGnwQ4HAUUKitvY7W1TOgjH9WQRHDlZs2-f2dSpv-af_-M23zwmzPf_fgdHa5l9IHzCrPjApZ51E90KIEE14DojrFG9UbrZXAiL9SoIa7zpxqEXNi5xhd4LY_04Lg06KaQWSgyd6IfOtkLH0fY6WujkEqRiWkBEKmf7WTDTBmt6lSecbSh7k9xGdFSm_jE5MTld19Wu5TvDVd_O5HSUhIShMjlVyPzxOitB5hUz7J77nMtXDlB53YBfmBLPhXgFePATOCQIhCU3p4vHW7EOhmlx3z2m3wD668ZPAAAA___SnGNx) she wouldn't seek reelection Tuesday, saying the federal government has been weakened by dysfunction and political extremes. Sinema is in her first term and publicly switched party affiliation from Democrat to Independent in 2022. [Her exit means](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7hwt7BpMQfGadHntlRaGJdk7bEcYJcp9_SlXXzmaYqT5uMyXIEW26_-wsm95n0Ns8uAZBzNomqlPPjNrxp69suAsjhapv_lMRqtEC5AayTjgJbPSk4tpsSqC7cVr0AQIRsFolDsBpcmNlBwrvUSNHQEnaXs9fe6ytRvn8tofXE9xX_vib63djw7_dfrc6XO4b_w83uoNtUks3Onz16sejbfhkI3XMIQq3_sWhgkIIyIimzTZFDQB5XFCdFmxYtNXn-5PKUUOYzuC6xqk_HbbXxN-AgAA__-jQlsv) Arizona voters will likely see a Senate race between Republican Kari Lake and Democrat Ruben Gallego. In a video [posted to social media](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1iYh409MHTxlq4dLQKP5LUYIqCx0q-v3Lnble5wjs7HZbtYipRu73ZH00LerGv0xA34xKXaVOdNQJQIHZpBi0XDqEF1dzPOGuA6DwKD0Dp4DWBnFwC888or25GRQioBYhrEOA1LL5Sfl1H5BQd5dRKYEuip5dJ_ZkrtjiG-8hNL7_LeRXNv7VEZvDG5Mrkex9G7a0141PNncj0nk-vXq9SGiVdKuFuecuPlOyVKN14QI7pGOfFThdtCPzlZXjHZhkyuXTH-cVCMVCfNlLjtluIfvv3X4jcAAP__f9thTA), Sinema said she was leaving the Senate because she believes in "civility, understanding, listening, working together to get stuff done."
## Report: Electric Cars More Toxic than Gas
Electric vehicles are [more harmful](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd0R4wOa5oHgNXbbd0sJmHM8KQ8QQZ_P3q2y9zW2udHR0Pq_zNVCifPsIB7q2lTmsjU6ctRwlmNl00W2IgLpD11s1WT1YbbrdBRijXvRiJgthxUUPdt0ms4UexwXAduRAgVFajb0axn66KBP_TYOJE_awrKCFURiplXr5KpTbjlt6lRPrZS1Hl9ze2p2F_i_AC_D5dS_c3pcA_wYL8Eq_ZxDglwdTRmYBHk-WFRMGRnmUirKVb1olHsRMJbMMFeWzVEa5lSrbjhLzSbXkA3OT3B7xJcB31cX7k1IiHq0w6nYESr9m7a9MPwEAAP__d5Vpsg) to the environment than gas-powered vehicles, according to a study from Emission Analytics that gained visibility after being cited in a recent Wall Street Journal op-ed. The study found that EV brakes and tires release "1,850 times more particles of pollution" than their combustible counterparts. [Lithium-ion batteries ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSpCAUheGnwQzrcqFRA4JNzHrTDS1aLsquQhewMv32Uz2TTv7VqVP_n_tyt-EIcfttTzLVp8WuNVy0SK45qkV1zngiJNmREQNMg7wNUnW7IQt6QvDSD6MUegSxjuvDP4D04Mm7LhgEVCBBC7hpMfWg3DjdlJtI4GNFyRSQCzXl_m8Kse7kj1e6KPdrOrvD7LU-C5O_GM4M59Za32zZQ9xqivRhzxC_KcM5UisMZ5xACqEYzqX-dy9-2n9U-GoLcboKbykX4j5lTvEKOcWTYuV1t5Fv9u3ye6TLxj1bOI5Q9MAUbKcNx9el-lOfzwAAAP__Z_doKQ)are the source of the excessive pollution. The batteries are heavy and cause tires and breaks to wear out faster. It is estimated that EVs produce about 20% more microplastic emissions than gas cars. Particle pollution has been linked to heart and lung disease and asthma. One California agency was [quick to defend EVs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D1y4yAUAODTQAfDr1gVFNuo87ZbahA8Wy9BwiOerPj2aVLmBN_M9_823xJW3B__0gaR7m1OmfAFsxWDMG52vMQ7gAHLIeqgxmB9sI6vMSzg3OhN8EobVcqy5JwXyH7RkLIuHKNRximrBq38oEepXPkzeldG0GbJxjKnoCC1Q3403GmFe323Fxwyt43XuBI9O7N_mZmYma7rkiVhfW8Jq8xNnp_MTD0j7BkI8srMlA7CXEFoq73XLjAzwUs8W60nYdvF1Y4OAr7WdHYSsGHv2PYuOp3lLVfaKj9ieV5YK_YhMKceP9rG6bec7wAAAP__k75oCg) and said manufacturers could offset the weight of EVs with lighter components.

| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e830e58e10e04d1e980c8f894bfb83e0&_e=9xYBb3poXIuFSvv-NNA3cCHYC-0iQtDXifYjq0kNe_PJftdnDTS9IsiOKYWsDP8tYtkhxU9AGkWvgShmG_JD-S2GE33KTsswbIAd0lA3HWrdau9FVKe2LKKDzbQ09r5R5wK_0iAMOIcssOnIoq9e9AreBuEnLFoHpaDb81QaioTHzlZpYENpk-kaeUOnlXXCQ88OMNHZSN487lMGtqBfBxFw3Cq-3f0LqvjsEoC3_X3QyDlODCUqxSQcAzmOJiw5cJ4r7im_vK3nz0qP6kSCkuqrGJS91F9X_B9GzDCf95l79qlc82mL7HihIO-NGgiWFrbl1SQFoTpdk27ypPQKX2mj6gQGfnuhqyYcOJWfrP6KDRtyqyPrveVp5V5tGnaiFJ9LrzChrpBGkjKm_jY2k_eKz7exobJAocvsvvYCzfzbPcPurW2f3CJW2NNyUTsy)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e830e58e10e04d1e980c8f894bfb83e0&_e=9xYBb3poXIuFSvv-NNA3cCHYC-0iQtDXifYjq0kNe_PJftdnDTS9IsiOKYWsDP8tYtkhxU9AGkWvgShmG_JD-S2GE33KTsswbIAd0lA3HWrdau9FVKe2LKKDzbQ09r5R5wK_0iAMOIcssOnIoq9e9AreBuEnLFoHpaDb81QaioTHzlZpYENpk-kaeUOnlXXCQ88OMNHZSN487lMGtqBfBxFw3Cq-3f0LqvjsEoC3_X3QyDlODCUqxSQcAzmOJiw5cJ4r7im_vK3nz0qP6kSCkuqrGJS91F9X_B9GzDCf95n-Mt3-B7s3MJy-YfL6P-tQevdonC6q6wfBqfkUlqHY3YfFfKkrnrC8W7y_QAE3099AT3zES0oYoW73GJZqRL1fXahLfqW8LmZBU7q6bAv1dRxZjsDak8pKNx7JYsKnS7kOjb8_8DTwNJ2Yq6ucmwg_).

body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I have even more news for you about our plans to “crash” President Joe Biden’s _State of the Union_ on Thursday night!

As I told you yesterday, there’s _**LOTS_** of speculation that the President’s special “guest” for his _State of the Union_ address will be someone he can use to push abortion throughout all nine months of a pregnancy.

That’s why, with a little help from U.S. Rep. Bob Good (R-VA) – _one of our strongest allies on Capitol Hill_ – we’re about to crash President Biden’s pro-abortion party as Rep. Good will be bringing a special guest of his own — my dear friend, _Ryan Bomberger._

As I told you, Ryan was conceived in rape. But his mother chose life and placed him with a loving, adoptive family. **Today, Ryan is a powerful pro-life speaker and activist.**

I can promise you that Ryan’s presence at the _State of the Union,_ proving that all human life is valuable, is going to make BOTH parties’ heads EXPLODE in Washington, D.C.

**_But we’re not stopping there!_**

In fact, tonight, we’re launching our 2024 Social Media Ambassador Program, which will use dedicated student activists to advance the pro-life message online and counter the Abortion Lobby’s lies that are going to be flooding social media on Thursday.

So, while the media elites are busy fuming over Ryan Bomberger being at the _State of the Union_. . .

You and I will be storming social media and converting thousands upon thousands of users to the Pro-Life Movement!

The great news is our social media platforms have an incredible reach, with our _Students for Life of America_ platforms alone having an estimated reach of **10,610,216** views per month!

**[So, can you please agree to a generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to help me kickstart our expansive Social Media Ambassador Program](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-skykhjd-duchtdja-y/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b4b4fbad16e84352a6365874b7adf536&_e=tJucpihXz5aIrYTsEIH72uuHAMdRFDH_SBKc_uouOcsw0acZMNvYHDehiFAD8DHlULEIWsEdhUpnFREJN42hF5CncmwHhsBZ6k9ucVWv4x_Ivx5ORNeBIL5xbJm7k05teBTCi7n4dlm-xYx_o3_FvCer8Npz-xgeEkavnmrQQG00L7NI06V98AElH3rCgvVyTTFbACa2LFsd6gLazgM_sPWFApfrjkO4ueI_TMdMUQis5U0NWvKR-e5EYVAWzNviqgBwaSWhkqT7hvRw0HrXgxPjod1-o__UlfJRL9sHWQdglaeF4S3iz2Q48ysBH1hKZS3EL7kOqVKTfVBG1VTPBCFoeJFiRS-k_Eecauy7cZpHNyzS_fc6kU1KE8Enoj3DAnsJVYcJ57_DWdC_2iDmtAO1KMXclmX6rxUR3TrGNY_jrKh6MdwOXLyA0mB_PgwT)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b4b4fbad16e84352a6365874b7adf536&_e=tJucpihXz5aIrYTsEIH72uuHAMdRFDH_SBKc_uouOcsw0acZMNvYHDehiFAD8DHlULEIWsEdhUpnFREJN42hF5CncmwHhsBZ6k9ucVWv4x_Ivx5ORNeBIL5xbJm7k05teBTCi7n4dlm-xYx_o3_FvCer8Npz-xgeEkavnmrQQG00L7NI06V98AElH3rCgvVyTTFbACa2LFsd6gLazgM_sPWFApfrjkO4ueI_TMdMUQis5U0NWvKR-e5EYVAWzNviqgBwaSWhkqT7hvRw0HrXgxPjod1-o__UlfJRL9sHWQfWEgIaV5p4JvZxknnfRTEtCDnLnrNpdXHCwg2d1yO886GsihFRoKFWrNyrfxRHeAye5_gJKbzhsgfdqrzYVjz0iRMpZ3FWf2t1UE_fEcHe7wNqC_B-004ZLWy-Q4PH-fPVEEiETT8H5JfUwPVoLNDF).

Peter-
Massachusetts primary voters have spoken! President Joe Biden is the overwhelming winner of our Democratic primary with xx% of the vote. When this vote is certified, President Biden should be awarded all 92 of our state’s pledged delegates.
Congratulate President Biden on his victory by making a donation HERE! [https://secure.joebiden.com/a/new-england-bvf-2?attr=11322054235435]
With our primary now complete, the Massachusetts Democratic Party is free to stand behind the Biden-Harris ticket, one hundred percent. The nomination may be all but secured. But our real work begins now .
If you're ready to go for Team Biden-Harris, sign up for the Democrats' Organizing Hub [https://democrats.org/take-action/] . There are several primaries ahead in key states. These include Georgia (March 12); Arizona, Florida, Ohio (March 19); Wisconsin (April 2); and Pennsylvania (April 23). These are opportunities to make sure Democrats’ voices are heard at the polls in these swing states and help the campaign take the President’s message of progress and opportunity into the general election.
You can sign up for the Biden-Harris team here [https://joebiden.com/] . Or you can donate to the coordinated campaign through the MassDems’ account here [https://secure.joebiden.com/a/new-england-bvf-2?attr=113220542] .
This Thursday, March 7th, at 9pm, President Biden will be delivering his third State of the Union address to Congress – and to all of us. You can sign up to host your own watch party here [https://democrats.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b575b9e5364b5673b6f9df3f1&id=a3594212be&e=09a669fade] , or you can join a virtual watch party here [https://democrats.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b575b9e5364b5673b6f9df3f1&id=2d53cc0c75&e=09a669fade] .
President Biden and Vice President Harris appreciate your support. Let’s help spread the word in Massachusetts and beyond to elect Democrats up and down the ballot – and to send Joe Biden and Kamala Harris back to the White House to finish the job for the American people.
Sincerely,

subject: Free eBook from Victor Davis Hanson: Dueling Populisms
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs8xo-fiN4

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os8xo-fiN4

Dear
Friend,
Populism
is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think
about American politics as being divided between the Left and the
Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been
seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat
and Republican establishment.

And
believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back
to Roman times.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to
make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks:
Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson.

Hanson is
a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think
you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important
eBook, you'll learn more about:

What
we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that
rebel against both the establishment-and each other.
The
important parallels between these ancient movements and their
modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative
populism.
What
lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our
culture.

You can
get your free copy of Dueling Populisms using this secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/dueling-populisms-signup/.

And
please feel free to share this with your family and friends. It's
important that we recall the voices of experience and apply them
to contemporary conflicts and challenges.

You can
use this link to get access to your free eBook right now.

Thanks,
Greg

Greg

Hoover

With its
eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the

security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have

United States and around the world.

| | | _**- A Personal Note from Congresswoman Young Kim - **_
Dear, Friend,

You may not know me, but this is Congresswoman Young Kim, and I would really appreciate it if you would take a moment to read my story.

I am a Christian, mother, wife, small business owner, and a first-generation immigrant.

When I moved to America, I didn't speak a word of English. But I worked hard, put myself through school, and am now one of the first Korean-American women to serve in Congress. But my road hasn't been exactly easy.

__In 2018, I ran for Congress and I lost my election.__

But I wouldn't let myself give up no matter how hard the Democrats tried to make me. So I ran again in 2020, and despite MILLIONS in spending against me, we won. **Together, we flipped a DEEP BLUE seat RED for the FIRST TIME in 26 years. **

Every year since then, we've continued to defy the odds to stop the woke Democrat machine and keep this seat for House Republicans.

_I 'm nothing special._ Just an immigrant who came to this country - not knowing a word of English - who lived the American Dream. And I've made it my mission on Capitol Hill to help make that same Dream possible for everyone.

But now, the Democrats are once again after my seat. They are angry that I flipped a deep Blue seat Red, and now they want it back. _The far-Left knows that my seat could very well decide the House Majority and they are DESPERATE for revenge. _

subject: I'm officially the Democratic nominee in Texas!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
We did it: I officially became the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas!
I am so grateful to my fellow Texas voters and grassroots supporters like you for entrusting me with this honor – I will not let you down.
I'm ready to outwork Ted Cruz to win this thing because the stakes of this election are too high not to. From voting rights to abortion, our freedoms are under attack. Everyday costs are still too high. Simply put: Texans cannot afford six more years of Ted Cruz.
That’s why this campaign is so important. Two recent polls showed us tied with Cruz, and I know we can win this race – but I need you with me to do it. So I have to ask: Will you donate $10 or $20 right now to help me and Serve America keep up last night's momentum all the way through Election Day? Every dollar helps as we work to build the massive grassroots movement it'll take to fire Ted Cruz. → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
The real race begins right now, and it's going to be a tough fight. But don't worry – I've been an underdog my whole life. I know what it takes to beat the odds and win a tough fight.
I'm a 4th generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom who sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. I never knew my dad but thanks to my community of teachers, coaches and counselors at the YMCA, who helped my mom, aunt and uncle raise me, I had the opportunity to chase my version of the American Dream.
Without them, I never would've made it to the NFL, gone to law school, become a civil rights lawyer, served in the Obama Administration, or run against a 22-year GOP incumbent and won, becoming the first Democrat to ever represent TX-32 in Congress.
And thanks to them, I am where I am today: the official Democratic nominee who has the chance to become Texas’ first Black Senator. The chance to finally defeat Ted Cruz and give Texans the committed leadership we deserve.

subject: Trump won. America lost.

body:
This is our reality.
| | |
---
Friend, it's official: Trump is the presumptive GOP nominee. This is a huge victory for far-right extremism and corrupt politicians like Rick Scott. **_But it is a devastating loss for America and all of us who are proud to call it home._**
It's hard to speak truthfully about Donald Trump without sounding hyperbolic: The GOP presidential nominee is a man who's facing **more than 90 criminal charges** , who incited **a deadly insurrection** to try to hold onto power, who **attacked our service members** and **praised foreign dictators** like Putin, who told grieving families to **"get over" a school shooting** , who spread lies and sowed chaos during **a deadly pandemic** , and who has promised to **be a dictator on “day one"** if he's reelected. _**This is our reality. **_**And this is who Rick Scott loves and proudly endorsed.**
Watching Trump's campaign as an American and a proud immigrant, I am infuriated, I am disappointed, and, truthfully, I am scared.
Many of us take a strong democracy, the peaceful transition of power, and the right to live in safety for granted. But I grew up in South America where political violence was far too normal. I know exactly how dangerous a man like Donald Trump can be if we allow him to take power.
Listen, people come to the United States for so many reasons. But underneath almost all those reasons is a need to feel _safe_. Safe to practice your religion, speak your mind, participate in elections, and exercise your freedoms. And a sense of financial safety, too. Living in a country with opportunities to build wealth, buy a home, and access affordable education is far too rare in our world.

**That's why, the moment that I took my naturalization oath to officially become a citizen here, I made a promise to _always_ protect the American Dream of safety and security that we're so fortunate to enjoy.**
Today, Donald Trump and extremists like Rick Scott are threatening that American Dream. _Ya no más_. Enough is enough. **I'm running for Senate to defeat Rick Scott, Donald Trump’s strongest ally in the Senate, and make sure****that generations of Americans can keep feeling safe the way that I finally did when I became a U.S. citizen.**
I know that this campaign has what it takes to win — polling shows our message of unity has already made this race a tie. **But Rick Scott is already spending millions to defeat us. name: Dr. Brian Williams
subject: Something bigger than myself
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Brian Williams for Congress
body:
| | Peter,

The results from the election are in, and while they’re not what we wanted, I’m deeply proud of what this campaign stood for: courage, integrity, and service before self.

Running for office was never about advancing my career or winning an election — it was about serving my community and fighting for a brighter future. Thank you for standing shoulder to shoulder with us in this fight to end gun violence, restore abortion rights, and fix our broken healthcare system.

Our movement changed the conversation and showed that new and diverse voices must be taken seriously. I will forever be grateful for your support.

I got into this race because I’ve had to pronounce too many victims dead on arrival due to gun violence and while this campaign is over, I look forward to continuing that work alongside the tireless friends and activists who were part of this team.

Onward,

Dr. Brian Williams

**Peter, I am honored to share that I've been named the new president of EMILYs List.**

The stakes of this year's elections couldn't be higher, **but I have spent my entire career taking on tough fights in Democratic politics, no matter how hostile the landscape**. I began my work right here at EMILYs List, where I gained a deep understanding of the barriers women — _and particularly women of color_ — face when they step up to run. EMILYs List taught me that to make progressive change, first and foremost, **we have to elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot, from coast to coast.** **And over the years, I have seen firsthand that through smart work and sheer grit, we _can_ change the face of power.**

Before returning to EMILYs List in 2021, I spent nearly a decade working at all levels of campaigns, all over the country. I packed up my condo just days after my wedding and moved west to run a U.S. Senate campaign in the Las Vegas desert. I went to the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee with a six-week old baby, where I led the most diverse independent expenditure team in the committee's history — a team that deployed a $90 million paid media strategy resulting in more than 40 Democratic House seat pickups.

**To put it plainly, Peter, I've never shied away from a tough fight.** Whenever I'm faced with an opportunity to work towards a better future for our country and our kids, I've always answered, "where do I sign up?"

**There is a fire of outrage in women everywhere** since _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned and Republicans enacted abortion bans all across the country. Women are rising up to say, _we will not be controlled by politicians who know nothing about our bodies and care less about our lives_. **This is the fight EMILYs List is built for, and our work to elect more women everywhere is the answer.** After all, it was another generation of pissed-off women that founded this organization to do just that nearly 40 years ago.

As I take on this new role, I am committed to growing our engagement with younger, more diverse women who will bring underrepresented perspectives to all levels of government. I look forward to serving our pro-choice community with tenacity and integrity.

Thank you for being with me in this fight,

Jessica

Jessica Mackler (she/her/hers)

Given how important Texas elections are for our prospects in this country,
I wanted to share some news with you about last night’s primary.

Voter turnout was down in Texas, by a lot. Just under 819,000 Democrats
voted — far less than even half of the 2.1 million who voted in the 2020
primaries.

With his wins here and in nearly every other primary, Donald Trump is all
but locked in as the GOP nominee. And several of his MAGA candidates
defeated Texas incumbents on promises to turn our state into an even
greater laboratory for extremism.

While last night’s results show how much more work we have left to do,
there’s still plenty of reason to have hope that we can turn this around
between now and November.

Three of the most competitive U.S. House races are right here in Texas,
and one of our very best chances of flipping a Senate seat lives in the
race to beat Ted Cruz.

I am increasingly concerned about how elected leaders and candidates are using religion as a political weapon| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=04f5a698fe7b45b3b268074fa6d5b0e1&_e=mYLXD_bvauzdRCL5ZSvbYDNEEJ3ZDc_7KPTlRS2hyJhs0ixPNkBarpCtu5BuDmSx3eumekjsV16ikkFdYcrUlDYqsVcjkCtArTUNKXPraH8zvTWe37ZsGBbmsUf8Qo5zDNfoF5uP-qebOKgISZYglZEuy1xCoAQN8hupNOKdcGtya-AViSDlgQtEmWcGxrQlO8dZyw5u3_swGU5UmNur6g%3D%3D)
---
Peter, I am increasingly concerned about how elected leaders and candidates are using religion as a political weapon.

Like many Americans, I am a person of faith, and I happen to be a Christian. My faith is something that is deeply personal to me and it helps guide me in the journey of my life. In Christianity, we teach kindness, love, compassion, understanding and seek to better control our inherent human emotions that can lead us to do things we may later regret. And the reality is that none of us is perfect. We are all flawed individuals, but it's our efforts to be better that define who we are and how we can ultimately make a positive impact for others.

When we have candidates who demonize other religions or use faith as a weapon to tear down political opponents, we all lose a part of what makes America so great. When we are told that people are "evil" because they practice other religions or have different opinions about policy issues, that only further divides us and makes it that much harder for us to return to a country where people can look at each other with a sense of compassion and understanding.

I don't write about my faith frequently, but sometimes we need to speak up when we see something we think is wrong. Here's a clip of me discussing this recently:

** _MORE UPDATES_ :** **Tackling America’s Youth Mental Health and Substance Use Crisis**
---
As a co-chair of the Bipartisan Policy Center’s Youth Mental Health and Substance Use Task Force, I recently visited Capitol Hill to advocate for evidence-based, actionable policy recommendations to help address our nation’s severe youth mental health and addiction crisis. In my role as a fellow for the [Bipartisan Policy Center](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=04f5a698fe7b45b3b268074fa6d5b0e1&_e=mYLXD_bvauzdRCL5ZSvbYBDRJrMzT7AXiqVs4zyaoYve6QbNshPf3mvKKsxGvbC00zMfv8Ie1pAzjSvyStIC06cdK-tq53vcWFRcgg-59t3_lctbLAH5vJiJK68p29dXqscb7CsgJOOHjIrAevRLFIqineccFvtf2Bo-i4j3khK1WKapKeVYQv_7rggWoko9Ow0A2FoP97N7ktsik1d3gg%3D%3D), I will help build a national strategy to reduce the prevalence of undetected and unaddressed mental health and substance use problems in youth.
---
---
There is so much complexity in our health care system, from how many providers we train, to how and where they are allowed to practice, to how they are paid – and so little of it is designed with children and youth in mind. We need to invest in policies that will reshape the future of health care delivery for youth and their caregivers.
---
---
|
---
**Providing a Beacon of Hope to Republicans Disappointed with Direction of the Party**
---
I recently had the opportunity to address participants at the [Principles First Summit](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=04f5a698fe7b45b3b268074fa6d5b0e1&_e=mYLXD_bvauzdRCL5ZSvbYPXs-_igW9KBJpp6TBekJ6TgPtuCNlBf5BVnXjvT6f_8nS37L_V31nEBSSm0vhHdOefDVkJhYnxtHcxicdWndp5FYHs1PpM2cerG5jqeeQZzr59FklfwejW6xNpaadcs_imDcRN_sLlKwc9PeIxuTy3_N70Ze2Z9PGGZO2At_9TiN-kF9xhqYAj6nnmUjpB9Cg%3D%3D) in Washington, D.C. The event focused on the power of principled leadership and the importance of putting country before party. You can watch my video remarks here:
---
[| | |
---|---|---](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=04f5a698fe7b45b3b268074fa6d5b0e1&_e=mYLXD_bvauzdRCL5ZSvbYNYfUZLeOB21fvUFJYlL2RSQTbP7MLTI11uuhZkADo9rOnEQkQQqmLGVKnk1HTHm-Tile7ogK45czfE3yJ0iJ49DIsJmSznLS-Cv7oINRxjC6pbQjY7pgy1o5sp6yg1jeGjNl8VsdZkYHjNn9nrcBLnq_UNtGGiJe1WDW2FdWuL4JA2PF08bWZg2EihLax3vQRAFJl8ihJbh1OD1JAa8xfM%3D "The 2024 Principles First Summit - Governor John Kasich speech")

We are stronger together and I'm so proud to have your support in this vital mission to heal America. But let me be clear: We can’t let up. Not one bit. [**The next eight months will present challenge after challenge. The general election starts now: Will you split a contribution between my campaign and Blue Amp Action now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93214581-a515-4c8f-90d9-067eaad22e15/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | | Early on, my parents taught me that some things are always worth fighting for — no matter the opposition. My dad helped found the first integrated law firm in North Carolina. He and his partners fought _against_ discrimination and _for_ equality. They kept up that fight even after extremists firebombed their office, burning it to the ground. **Today, we’re once again at a crossroads. Extremists in North Carolina and across the country are threatening the values we hold most dear. ** Mark Robinson – a conspiracy theorist and far-right extremist – was just selected to lead the top of the ticket for NC’s GOP in November. He’s pushing for a total ban on abortion, promising to further strip funding for public schools, and threatening North Carolinians’ voting rights. He’s also touted dangerous conspiracy theories: calling a school shooting survivor a “crisis actor,” questioning whether 9/11 was an inside job, and claiming the Holocaust was “hogwash.” Mark Robinson is one of the most extreme statewide-elected Republicans _in the country_ – and yet the latest polls show us statistically TIED. name: Patti Reilly
subject: My son was wrongly convicted
body:
I'm praying you will help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkE-LszAchD9NvEVi_urBQ4vaSy2lb-E9hpj8bAOJlRjZr7-07N73-jAM88z_UY_GB788LiZCm1PWacl6cjpAcDNOsGQTNCWUY8IwkZoWruWKOiYLaCtFGsVlI0TxbGdrJkeIVNSC5LIWztbgGssInYypbeHbdw9hRFaSC0pLSa0SUCmgM3dAGOLEBEh5K_MTEqz7FLw1SwYTS_uKRWifOa8bYgdEB0SHDeyeoDQLuFd-JxAdPrsRHRppKwaTxZNQAnMhJG7qRuJJkLkiTQUABLFhz1Fvrz1ZQKw7did86y-IyjeO4PweEev68YdYE1fjHwti3a-JPnYnfe7P3aD_jeervvUXfT3g--1epNatXz4Ev0mFOHlE48NHI__p5-8AAAD__3XDfz0)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkE-LszAchD9NvEVi_urBQ4vaSy2lb-E9hpj8bAOJlRjZr7-07N73-jAM88z_UY_GB788LiZCm1PWacl6cjpAcDNOsGQTNCWUY8IwkZoWruWKOiYLaCtFGsVlI0TxbGdrJkeIVNSC5LIWztbgGssInYypbeHbdw9hRFaSC0pLSa0SUCmgM3dAGOLEBEh5K_MTEqz7FLw1SwYTS_uKRWifOa8bYgdEB0SHDeyeoDQLuFd-JxAdPrsRHRppKwaTxZNQAnMhJG7qRuJJkLkiTQUABLFhz1Fvrz1ZQKw7did86y-IyjeO4PweEev68YdYE1fjHwti3a-JPnYnfe7P3aD_jeervvUXfT3g--1epNatXz4Ev0mFOHlE48NHI__p5-8AAAD__3XDfz0)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.
