body:
I know you and I have never met. But I’m praying that you’ll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KE9AkwAU2tWFpm898nyGgg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyzqwP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA2X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZeOdoehlIALhllIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KE9AkwAU2tWFpm898nyGgg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyzqwP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA2X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZeOdoehlIALhllIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KE9AkwAU2tWFpm898nyGgg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyzqwP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA2X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZeOdoehlIALhllIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KE9AkwAU2tWFpm898nyGgg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyzqwP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA2X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZeOdoehlIALhllIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/KE9AkwAU2tWFpm898nyGgg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnyzqwP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzA2X0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZeOdoehlIALhllIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

What a great night for the American People last night as we watched President Trump take home massive Victories on Super Tuesday, including here in Colorado!
However, the fight to Make America Great Again is far from over.
Tomorrow and Saturday, Colorado Republicans will turn out for our Caucuses across the state.
When I was in Las Vegas last month I recorded this message with Turning Point Action, in order to share with you why I am the best and most qualified candidate to serve as your next Republican National Committeewoman.
It is my hope that after watching this video I can count on your support tomorrow and Saturday at Caucus when you run to become a delegate to the State Convention on April 6th in Pueblo, CO.
This election for Committeewoman takes place at state convention and becoming a delegate is the only way you can cast a vote in this pivotal, and vitally important race.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ake-cd18-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ake-cd18-email]
Peter,
We launched this campaign on Juneteenth, surrounded by friends, family, and a coalition of community members who were ready to move our community forward. When we knocked on doors and listened to people, we also heard that people wanted solutions and transformative change. The same holds true for the community today.
This campaign was never about one person. It was about you - the community.
I would like to express my gratitude to my family, friends, volunteers, donors, supporters, and my team for their extraordinary efforts and support of my bid for Congress. Although we did not win the race, we empowered the community. I am grateful for that for all of you! Thank you for all of your support!
I congratulate Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee on her victory. As a result of this race, may the issues that matter most get resolved.
Let’s remain engaged so that the community can reach its full potential. Thank you for all of your help and support!
Onwards,

clean_body: [] Peter, We launched this campaign on Juneteenth, surrounded by friends, family, and a coalition of community members who were ready to move our community forward. When we knocked on doors and listened to people, we also heard that people wanted solutions and transformative change. The same holds true for the community today. This campaign was never about one person. It was about you - the community. I would like to express my gratitude to my family, friends, volunteers, donors, supporters, and my team for their extraordinary efforts and support of my bid for Congress. Although we did not win the race, we empowered the community. I am grateful for that for all of you! Thank you for all of your support! I congratulate Congresswoman Sheila Jackson Lee on her victory. As a result of this race, may the issues that matter most get resolved. Let’s remain engaged so that the community can reach its full potential. Thank you for all of your help and support! name: Christian
subject: Thank you
body:
Fellow Patriot,
Last night's election results are difficult to accept. More than anything, I'm disappointed your efforts won't be celebrated.
The outcome is not the one we desired, but the hard work, passion, and time each of one you put forward for the last two weeks, two months or two years means the absolute world to me, Sharon and Sarah.
Thank you!
Thank you for the phone calls you made, the doors you knocked, the yard signs you put out, the events you attended and hosted, the polls you worked, and the financial contributions you made to our campaign. All of it was a gift and blessing.
The voters of the 6th Congressional District made a choice last night, and while I'd hoped the choice they made was different; I accept it. I wish the two candidates headed for a runoff good luck, and I call upon them to listen to your voices, your concerns, your priorities, and your fears rather than taking the marching orders or plays they are calling from the sidelines in Washington DC.
The issues are still the same. We must secure our border. We must regain American sovereignty. We must eliminate inflation and Biden's failed economic policies. We must establish economic prosperity. And we must project Peace through Strength. Our adversaries must fear us, and not threaten our interests economically, domestically, or abroad.
Thank you again from myself, Sharon, and Sarah for your friendship, generosity, and hard work on behalf of our campaign.
Respectfully,
Christian Castelli
Lieutenant Colonel (Retired), United States Army Special Forces
[castellifornc.com](https://castellifornc.com)
This email was sent to **dpwillis67@gmail.com** from **christian@castellifornc.com**.
If you do not wish to receive further messages from us, [ please click here to unsubscribe](https://emailtracking-cm.aristotle.com/frmEmailUnsubscribe.aspx?databaseId=b33a3810-9cbf-4584-a3d2-01672886537a&activityID=54d8d676-5e9a-46ac-bf45-e98bbe549ae8).

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Each day that passes, more innocent civilians are going hungry in Gaza as
the Israeli military blocks most aid trucks from reaching those in need.
Babies and children are now dying of starvation and dehydration, and
countless more will face life-long mental and physical impacts of
malnutrition.

At this point, the majority of Palestinians lack access to clean drinking
water, over 90% of the population faces high levels of food insecurity,
and experts from the World Food Programme to Doctors Without Borders warn
a man-made famine is dangerously close.

In January, the United States cut funding for one of Gaza’s largest
sources of aid, the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) before
Israel even provided any evidence to prove their claims.

Yesterday, it was reported that Canada would resume and increase funding
for UNRWA after seeing the UN’s report on Israel’s allegations.

Every day that our country withholds this vital funding, more innocent
people will die. That’s why Justice Democrats incumbents in Congress are
leading the call for the U.S. to restore full funding to UNRWA as soon as
possible.

Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=28448b309e504fc48369de7aa58d35d0&_e=axAedTWKU5i1lXkPglvaVnllOB-IN4yojsHPddEikewDYopmRJfETrmny9_n7GpBSCcPQxYubDf3jKJq-2-cFsHSl5id7pzK5PSRVlL_13ST4fZ9NYoUYKADq01yXpt-O4hAAez1ujxhfn7JgIeV73qwEr2-PMltb3Fa_BBXfMFfFj8eBhXpybYWC5GOFRsoXHiiBh1m97DObceOpq4oeZf4dVCFgLACNEulM7hKlxXTU6ROl36stM1q2GFaIdGH4g0Op4ixRtaN_sloMRL0UoLnNwudJdY7ktTrQwF-iJJwv7DpAlO7J6vJ-fnILfJHjJTQ4oOcfZx4ZoHeJY98W9bPY33etO7U6rnylk64MiWSedzhCzA5K8IAFwFxUF1_w-YDUCxwHPdhS9DVuwiio3J19eiEGe4F9TF2tKGhHydVmgulICenX93m8IM3YMMYAWH2n4GgJsWCg0BzwfAo4qmNCSX5bcA-RSgWpKAq7DlQvSj3FmvNtdv4OP4pdy8_WqL4e5FOjKAUjgi66VBRuA%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me.

Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God.

**[So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight?](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=28448b309e504fc48369de7aa58d35d0&_e=axAedTWKU5i1lXkPglvaVnllOB-IN4yojsHPddEikewDYopmRJfETrmny9_n7GpBSCcPQxYubDf3jKJq-2-cFsHSl5id7pzK5PSRVlL_13ST4fZ9NYoUYKADq01yXpt-O4hAAez1ujxhfn7JgIeV73qwEr2-PMltb3Fa_BBXfMFfFj8eBhXpybYWC5GOFRsoXHiiBh1m97DObceOpq4oeZf4dVCFgLACNEulM7hKlxXTU6ROl36stM1q2GFaIdGH4g0Op4ixRtaN_sloMRL0UoLnNwudJdY7ktTrQwF-iJJwv7DpAlO7J6vJ-fnILfJHjJTQ4oOcfZx4ZoHeJY98W9bPY33etO7U6rnylk64MiWSedzhCzA5K8IAFwFxUF1_TtLEdtIjZVY3Kp2ELSTclQUmDYh5uvUDR5P6XG7A9HVaJSu2CMkRpK7aPkzdOZHeVBPHxfV0I3zfSwxA1s5cJWR980rvXSgC5Oy5g--vcANYIpHQEXQlGfEyOK9rk_Z12b1WF1PrNhxO9q5O4vWIzQ%3D%3D "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? name: Madeleine Dean
subject: ❌ No Fraud in AI
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mad4PA PAC
body:
**** Peter, I wanted to make sure you saw the news about a piece of legislation I recently introduced – the bipartisan _No AI FRAUD Act._

As emerging technology, AI presents both challenges and opportunities – some exciting, some dangerous. You’ve probably heard of something called a _“deepfake”_ – an image or recording that has been altered to misrepresent the subject. With AI, bad actors can manipulate video or audio to give the appearance that someone did or said something when that’s not the case. _You can see the threat to our safety, privacy, and trust online._

That’s why my colleagues and I introduced the _No AI FRAUD Act_ to **give all Americans the tools to protect and defend our right to our own voice and likeness.**

Here’s how this legislation works:
* Creates an intellectual property right that every individual holds over their own likeness and voice
* Allows individuals to seek monetary damages for harmful, unauthorized uses of their likeness or voice

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80443218/459345936/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWM0ZTAyNzQtZTlkYi1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=EEfXakJnNGF5i_1LhoShIj43p5w90c7cin8kG3I2DT8=&emci=66fd506c-e9db-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=9c4e0274-e9db-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
It’s official, Peter.
Super Tuesday results are in, Nikki Haley is out, and Donald Trump is the Republican Party’s presidential nominee.

Peter,
Right now, Arizona’s border communities need solutions to deal with the escalating number of migrants overwhelming border personnel. They don’t need another photo op with Republican members of Congress.
Republicans like Juan Ciscomani are failing us on the border. You can read my new op-ed where I unpack this issue here >> [https://www.gvnews.com/opinion/juan-ciscomani-is-failing-us-on-the-border/article_e3c6548a-da9c-11ee-bcb7-6fab2ca01a09.html]

Washington has let us down.
We need leadership who will set aside the politics and focus on getting us the resources we need.
The bipartisan border deal isn’t perfect, but it would make a huge difference. It would help fund temporary migrant shelters, speed up the processing of asylum claims, and keep our ports of entry open. It includes $1.4 billion dollars to prevent unsheltered street releases by supporting centers like Casa Alitas in Tucson.
Donald Trump rejected the deal — so, of course, Ciscomani and his GOP cronies followed suit.
Ciscomani has chosen division and fear-mongering over progress. In Congress, I’ll always put the interests of my constituents first.

| | Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them. **That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, ["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=50e0f7fc153a45ba882aeec0eb6346db&_e=jP0RfGQeqZcRlClddaSWPem3W7dV8L9i66IFhYblb1e5k4CWdXUQsR7wvSvymzEYbFUHw2qgfObq0_MaHHU-pxWKSn0loGECgRcjcJgkkjariI8K0aoNNHTBP34iLNSX-t3DOZklR_-ymJV5Im3xEiu2H5GnS-wTAdUywh4cds2E8YVkPDg8l-Pkzt4MjlFJ-p2tZCnzSfoT_jCA8EPdSb2FHSa7CllxP2Cy21zJeLHyHc3fiASKJg5uBPBdFQ_hgsJZUva6LAIUqYHIV0Wu6edp110rD6s85w3ukaYEnLRiBS49Nhs8L2niiuUj9Ln9n8j6n6-yNBsJMo6YekIa_RHTIBOryhDwltfvmUGtqkaYeNUOSPJAR4jiilVefNakQoLJwUQJ3YH6j2xfKqZMX-UavsvBrRVGsv_-9tdwivKK679gZfSu_2pwzbqXsT2b)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

clean_body: “The Constitution is kind of trash.” | | | | Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is flawed , outdated , and incapable of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: The Federalist Papers. | | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, The Federalist Papers were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them. That 's why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. | | | " The Federalist Papers" course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. Hillsdale's faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. charges, including obstruction of justice, extortion and honest
services wire fraud in a superseding indictment filed Tuesday.

If you're unfamiliar, it's a plan aimed at reshaping the US Government should Donald Trump be reelected. The strategy, in essence, involves firing government workers and replacing them with Trump loyalists, intending to transform government agencies into tools of the President.In Yakima, our newly elected city council comprises five MAGA patriots, whose election methods are questionable. It seems they may have utilized their church, where they all attend, to run their political campaign. Additionally, one council member doesn't even reside in Yakima.Their initial action was to immediately fire the city manager by 'Suspending the Rules.' Now, they are poised to diminish the significance of committees like the Historic Preservation Committee, Bike and Pedestrian Committee, and the Yakima Tree Board by making them subcommittees of the planning board. Furthermore, they plan to remove the Community Integration Committee (diversity focus) and the Sustainable Yakima Committee from the city code. This move stifles community input in the decision-making process. It's [Project 25](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=-QdC2CkCv8qg1mgi-Ir0jKLmQ9RLFNlFzHmJcyq-9tg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucHJvamVjdDIwMjUub3JnLyIsInIiOiI2NjViNzE5My1mNDc2LTRmNGQtYjViYS0zNDE5NzBjZDZhZTciLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) in action. | | 3\. Turning the Tide: Inspiring Voter Engagement in Upcoming Elections
---
| | The biggest threat to the upcoming election is lack of interest in the election. John Halpin, writing for [The Liberal Patriot](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=qp-ULWX2sh8_VFJhcQxdKko1HZC7OpuOLT-xmCKTp2A.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGliZXJhbHBhdHJpb3QuY29tL3AvYW1lcmljYW5zLWFyZW50LXBheWluZy1jbG9zZS1hdHRlbnRpb24iLCJyIjoiMGRkZjZjN2EtMTIwOC00MWVlLTE1MDMtNmM4ZTM4ZGYyMTI5IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0), speaks to an Economist/YouGov poll showing that the majority of potential voters could not care less about the election.
---
| [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=FNpO8qTVcbGXZze8WarPfe1GiwUyN1vZOSKbCfkyh4M.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGliZXJhbHBhdHJpb3QuY29tL3AvYW1lcmljYW5zLWFyZW50LXBheWluZy1jbG9zZS1hdHRlbnRpb24iLCJyIjoiZDNjOTcyZWUtZWIwZS00YjY4LWU0YTYtZDZmMTIxMmMwNjFhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | But where do we find hope in re-engaging people in the political process? Firstly, we're in a better position than we think. According to the [Washington Secretary of State](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=Z8rOHtzBhGjdYaiqRXluD8SLlf7yDaIE51Tzm4w3M9M.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc29zLndhLmdvdi8iLCJyIjoiZjdmODBmMzgtMTBhNS00NWY1LTg5MGMtMmQ1YThjMmExZWM5IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) the average voter turnout in Central Washington is pretty close to the national average of 66%, and considering that only 37% of eligible voters participated in all of the last three Presidential Elections, we're doing relatively well ([Pew Research, July 2022](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=_CGDGLf-UA_CsGctMH4lEzw5STJlsvlHiCBu_7g24XU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGV3cmVzZWFyY2gub3JnL3BvbGl0aWNzLzIwMjMvMDcvMTIvdm90ZXItdHVybm91dC0yMDE4LTIwMjIvIiwiciI6ImY3ZjgwZjM4LTEwYTUtNDVmNS04OTBjLTJkNWE4YzJhMWVjOSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)). Why do we look good? Because we have four of the five lowest-scoring subgroups on that poll: Income under $50,000, Hispanic, Age 18-29, and Independent. There is literally nowhere to go but up.Additionally, the top concerns of Americans - Inflation, Healthcare, Immigration, and Jobs - are also our concerns ([Economist/YouGov poll](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=v5oSS7nKvRs_T9kG_J_RyOQOkE-WO9dTEJXvlylWPtc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly90b2RheS55b3Vnb3YuY29tL3RvcGljcy9wb2xpdGljcy9leHBsb3JlL3RvcGljL1RoZV9FY29ub21pc3RfWW91R292X3BvbGxzIiwiciI6ImY3ZjgwZjM4LTEwYTUtNDVmNS04OTBjLTJkNWE4YzJhMWVjOSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9), select poll 6. Most Important Issues). So, we have two significant advantages: we're starting from an average position, and we have a large portion of our population that still does not vote but can. Furthermore, we share the concerns of many others, which means we have the support of others who will be working on this issue. There's further encouragement from an unlikely source. The Republican Party in Central Washington is making strides in getting voter turnout among the younger population, which is encouraging. In fact, if voter turnout in the recent primary is any indication, the Republican Party dominates our youth in Central Washington.Rural Americans United emphasizes that over 80% of the people living in Central Washington have not heard a pro-democratic message. And for those under 25, it's closer to 100%!

| There's no better proof than seeing [17-year-olds who voted in the primary](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/d3OuL0RhH/c?w=DoGytA7JJKddZXfaR4NXjqUZkPzBCY6yBwj5iJ5RSu4.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc29zLndhLmdvdi9lbGVjdGlvbnMvZGF0YS1yZXNlYXJjaC9lbGVjdGlvbi1kYXRhLWFuZC1tYXBzL2JhbGxvdC1yZXR1cm4tc3RhdGlzdGljcyIsInIiOiJhOTcxNjMwMC00ZWMzLTRiOWMtOGI5MS0wMzc2MzNjMzVkMzgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) almost exclusively supporting the Republican Party. That's why we broadcast pro-democratic messages - to educate, remind, and persuade people that democratic values are their values. Otherwise, all they hear is Republican Party rhetoric. And our young adults deserve better.

| | Peter, I don't want to take up too much of your time, but wow.
**Thanks to support from grassroots donors, we were able to _meet and surpass_ February's End of Month Fundraising Goal. **
This is great news – in the shortest month of the year, folks across the district helped our team pull through. And while our people-powered campaign's strength continues to grow, I'm reaching out to say _**we're not out of the woods yet. **_

See, our quarterly reporting deadline is just a few weeks away, and the following report is an important tool to show journalists, analysts and even the GOP how much my message resonates with people in our district.

Peter, I am so grateful for the energy, dedication and generosity folks have shown me and my team so far, but it is so important that we don't let our foot off the gas.

[**Besides showing our strength on paper, your support is crucial to helping me and my team connect with voters, share my story, and secure essential campaign materials. | | | Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family.

The proud product of public schools, Emily worked hard in and out of the classroom, balancing her studies and interest in performing arts with an after-school job as a cashier at Ace Hardware. She went on to earn her B.A. in Biology from Indiana University and Masters from Michigan State University.

Now, Emily is running for Congress in Michigan’s 10th District to keep our kids safe, protect our rights, and lower costs for Michigan families.

Emily chose to move to Oakland County two decades ago because it was the place she wanted to raise her family – a place with friendly neighbors, good schools, and safe neighborhoods.

We did it, Peter: I officially became the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas!

# ONLY 3 MORE DAYS
---
|
Friends, Only 3 more days until the Virginia General Assembly adjourns, on Saturday, March 9, 2024. Then Governor Youngkin has 30 days, April 8, to veto, sign into law or amend legislation that has passed both the House and Senate, with exception.
There are roughly 100 bills already sitting on Governor Youngkin's desk that require action before midnight on Friday, March 8. These are bills that were signed by both House Speaker and Senate President before last Friday.
Many bills under the accelerated timeline address top issues such as gun control legislation, reproductive rights and raising the state's minimum wage floor.
Among the so-called seven-day bills:
* Banning legacy university admissions,
* Re-enrolling in a program to share voter information with other states,
* Requiring health insurance cover contraception.

name: Wes Moore
subject: False choices
body:
Friend,

The last thing I wanted at age thirteen was to be sent off to military school.

Little did I know that it would change the trajectory of my life and still shape who I am today over three decades later.

As a troubled kid in The Bronx, I first felt handcuffs on my wrists when I was eleven years old. I was on academic and disciplinary probation, so my mom made the difficult decision to send me to Valley Forge Military Academy.

The transition was hard. I tried to run away at first, but at the end of my first year, I realized that I was growing up. I realized that the structure was something that I’d never found before. Finally, I felt like I was part of something bigger, part of a team, and it actually mattered to people that I was there.

When it was time to think about what was next after high school, the people that I admired most in my life happened to be in uniform. So for me, the answer was clear. I would train to become an Army officer.
I didn’t join the Army because I wanted to go to war. I didn’t join the Army because I had a lust or a need to go overseas and fight.

I joined the Army because I was inspired by my mentors in military school, because I felt that patriotic call to serve that so many young people feel.

By the time I finished my studies and was getting ready to deploy to Afghanistan, there were soldiers in my unit who were now on their second and third deployments. Everyone had different reasons for signing up.
But one thing was common among all of us. We were taught to leave no one behind, and it’s a lesson that has stuck with me.

When fellow soldiers were in distress nobody asked if they were Democrats or Republicans. I’ve seen patriotism with my own eyes and it’s not red or blue. I saw it with the paratroopers that I led in combat, people who were exemplifying bravery every single day. Believing that your neighbors or fellow soldiers deserve support is patriotism to me.

I believe that fighting for one another is going to be the key to our success – and that service will save us. Too often, we continue to be sold false choices as a way of dividing us. As a way of asking us which tribe we belong to.

I believe that we can be more competitive and support economic growth and at the same time say that the economy needs to work for everybody, not just the people who are privileged and who’ve written the rules. Both these things can exist in the same sentence.

As your Governor, I will continue to live by the values I learned throughout my military career and make sure that no one is left behind. I will continue to fight against false choices that seek to divide us, and instead work to make sure that everyone is included.

Elevate,

Wes Moore

That’s all I’m asking, Peter.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1050%2E62735%2EVWQHdz)
**Peter, we’re exactly five months away from primary day in Michigan.** This is our opportunity to reject six more years of the same failed, out-of-touch, establishment “leadership” in Washington.
When I look at Michigan today, I see single moms working two jobs just to make ends meet. I see working families choosing between groceries and health insurance. I see folks filing for bankruptcy because of sky-high medical debt, all while Big Pharma rakes in record profits.
This isn’t the American dream — it's the product of career politicians putting power over the people.
That’s why I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors to run a grassroots, people-powered campaign. **Our broken system allows the rich and powerful to buy the election results THEY want, and Peter — it’s time to bring the system down.**
[**So, with 5 months to go until the Michigan Senate primary, will you chip in just $5 to reject the status quo and WIN this high-stakes race for our future?**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/712?t=2&akid=1050%2E62735%2EVWQHdz)
You don’t have to run for office to know that the system is rigged towards the wealthy and well-connected, or that our leaders in Washington are totally out of touch with the problems on the ground. **That’s why rejecting the establishment is key to unlocking Michigan’s true potential.**
On August 6th, we have a chance to buck the establishment and build a real progressive future in Michigan. We have a chance to end the Senate filibuster and pass historic reforms, from delivering universal healthcare to raising the federal minimum wage. We have a chance to get money out of politics and _finally_ put Washington back to work for the people.
**But we can’t bring this system down if we don’t out-hustle our opponent every single day between now and the election.**
So here’s the deal: My opponent had a head start in this race and is backed by the Washington establishment. As a political outsider, I’m at a serious disadvantage — no buts about it. But the sooner we can deploy our campaign’s resources and reach more voters, the sooner we can take the lead in these next five months and _win._
**And since I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, my campaign needs _every_ dollar we can get right now.**
This is our moment, and we need to seize it, Peter. **[With 5 months to go until the primary, can I count on you to chip in just $5 to our grassroots, people-powered campaign for Michigan?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/712?t=3&akid=1050%2E62735%2EVWQHdz)**

This is our opportunity to reject six more years of the same failed, out-of-touch, establishment “leadership” in Washington. When I look at Michigan today, I see single moms working two jobs just to make ends meet. I see working families choosing between groceries and health insurance. I see folks filing for bankruptcy because of sky-high medical debt, all while Big Pharma rakes in record profits. This isn’t the American dream — it's the product of career politicians putting power over the people. That’s why I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors to run a grassroots, people-powered campaign. Our broken system allows the rich and powerful to buy the election results THEY want, and Peter — it’s time to bring the system down. You don’t have to run for office to know that the system is rigged towards the wealthy and well-connected, or that our leaders in Washington are totally out of touch with the problems on the ground. That’s why rejecting the establishment is key to unlocking Michigan’s true potential. On August 6th, we have a chance to buck the establishment and build a real progressive future in Michigan. We have a chance to end the Senate filibuster and pass historic reforms, from delivering universal healthcare to raising the federal minimum wage. We have a chance to get money out of politics and finally put Washington back to work for the people. But we can’t bring this system down if we don’t out-hustle our opponent every single day between now and the election. So here’s the deal: My opponent had a head start in this race and is backed by the Washington establishment. As a political outsider, I’m at a serious disadvantage — no buts about it. But the sooner we can deploy our campaign’s resources and reach more voters, the sooner we can take the lead in these next five months and win. And since I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, my campaign needs every dollar we can get right now. This is our moment, and we need to seize it, Peter. Thank you for your support, Hill Harper Democrat for U.S. Senate

I never knew my dad but thanks to my community of teachers, coaches, and counselors at the YMCA, who helped my mom, aunt, and uncle raise me, I had the opportunity to chase my version of the American dream.

Friend, Tomorrow, President Biden will deliver the annual State of the Union address. Millions of Americans will tune in to watch his televised speech to Congress. On the same day, organizations around the country are preparing a People’s State of the Union rally in Washington, D.C. to express outrage that our government keeps handing over billions of our tax dollars to fund war and genocide—all while neglecting our communities’ urgent needs in the United States. Their main demands are: “Immediate and permanent ceasefire now! Stop U.S. aid for Israel’s genocide against Palestinians! **Our democracy is stronger today because of your work with the NDRC. But our work is far from complete. **
Too many voters are still being silenced by gerrymandering. Too many people are being deliberately left out of our democracy thanks to rising attacks on voting rights. And unlike the days when congressional and legislative districts were redrawn once a decade, these fights are now happening every year in every corner of the country. In fact, several maps hang in the balance as I write this.

President Obama

Bob Lorinser (D, MI01) is somewhat of an anomaly; Because of his broad people-powered support across his district, he doesn't struggle to raise donations, $1 at a time. Yet...

Bob's corporate-funded opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger. For a real shot, a serious candidacy to take on big money in November, Bob needs your help now. Every single dollar [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] is making a big difference.
CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
Bob's candidacy and the everyday people who fuel it are living proof that the system should be different; that we don't need to kowtow to special interests, corporate PACs, or ultra wealthy donors looking for political influence to win.
It's time to give the
power back to the people!
This morning, Bob took the 'American Promise Candidate Pledge,' a volunteer-led effort that aims to get candidates to pledge on the record that they will use their office to advance the 'For Our Freedom Amendment,' a constitutional amendment to completely stop corporate influence in politics.
Because of the generosity of donors like you, Bob has received exponentially more small-amount contributions than his competitors, which demonstrates that we can have candidates with integrity who can still compete.
We are grateful. Let's continue the momentum, give what you can, and and dream big.

Kevin

body:
Ruben is a Marine, a leader in his community, and a champion of the causes we all support
#

Friend, you know I've been working hard to hold control of the Senate.
It’s incredibly important, and winning in Arizona is critical to that goal.
That’s why I’m very proud to tell you that I’m endorsing Ruben Gallego and his campaign for U.S. Senate. [**And it's why I'm asking you, very humbly, to split a donation between his campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg.wM1wBl&refcode=em240306-1-500&t=1&akid=5720%2E6688874%2ELaWu_Q)

Ruben is a Marine, a leader in his community, and a champion of the causes we all support, like abortion rights and protecting our democracy. I’m especially proud to endorse Ruben because I know he’s a fighter.
We need fighters right now because we must defeat Kari Lake. She’s one of the most dangerous politicians in the country, and we’re going to fight like hell to keep her out of the Senate.
This is going to be a really close race, and victory or defeat will come down to whether Ruben can raise the resources he needs to win.
It’s why emails like this are so important, and it’s why I’ve got to ask you one more time:
[**Please, split a donation of $3 or whatever you can afford between my campaign and Ruben's.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg.wM1wBl&refcode=em240306-1-500&t=3&akid=5720%2E6688874%2ELaWu_Q)

My dad helped found the first integrated law firm in North Carolina. He and his partners fought _against_ discrimination and _for_ equality. They kept up that fight even after extremists firebombed their office, burning it to the ground.

James Thomas, a self-professed far-left employee at Ole Miss, often betrays his lack of nuanced thinking through his musings, yet even he occasionally hits the mark. Last week, he posed a question to Mississippians that resonated deeply: "Did we turn Mississippi blue and just not know it?"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7c2c17a8-b4ba-45c9-86cf-8a5c1eabbc43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Regrettably, it seems James Thomas may have a point. Mississippi, under the guise of Republican leadership, appears to have embraced policies more aligned with liberal agendas.
Despite staunch resistance from Democrats, Mississippi has steadfastly refused to expand Obamacare to cover able-bodied adults. Other states' experiences have underscored the folly of extending free health insurance to those capable of working but choosing not to. Such policies not only prove prohibitively expensive but also undermine healthcare access for those truly in need.
However, the landscape has shifted in the Mississippi House of Representatives. Democrats masquerading as conservative Republicans have seized control, shedding their camouflage.
For those of us who've been vigilant over the years, this comes as no surprise. We've sounded the alarm about Delbert Hosemann and Jason White's true allegiances, only to be dismissed as obstinate troublemakers. After years of resistance, many of us relented, only to witness the new leadership force-feed Obamacare policies to Mississippians within two months of taking office.
## The question now looms: What next?
Hopefully, the Republican establishment and influential stakeholders have recognized the validity of our warnings. Perhaps now, Mississippians will awaken to the imperative for change, abandoning blind loyalty to familiar faces.
The expansion of Obamacare in the Mississippi House unfolded without debate, scrutiny, or dissenting voices. None. It's a betrayal to the very people the legislature is sworn to protect. Any legislator complicit in this betrayal must face consequences at the ballot box. Remember, forgive not, forget not--they must be held accountable.

Despite staunch resistance from Democrats, Mississippi has steadfastly refused to expand Obamacare to cover able-bodied adults. Other states' experiences have underscored the folly of extending free health insurance to those capable of working but choosing not to. Such policies not only prove prohibitively expensive but also undermine healthcare access for those truly in need. However, the landscape has shifted in the Mississippi House of Representatives. The question now looms: What next? Hopefully, the Republican establishment and influential stakeholders have recognized the validity of our warnings. Perhaps now, Mississippians will awaken to the imperative for change, abandoning blind loyalty to familiar faces. The expansion of Obamacare in the Mississippi House unfolded without debate, scrutiny, or dissenting voices. None. It's a betrayal to the very people the legislature is sworn to protect. Any legislator complicit in this betrayal must face consequences at the ballot box. Remember, forgive not, forget not--they must be held accountable. # 2024 March e-newsletter
News and information for District 5 in San Mateo County.
---
|
---
|
---
| **County offers new lifeline for those in mental health crisis**
---
| Dear friends, The Board of Supervisors unanimously voted Tuesday, February 27 to adopt a resolution authorizing a $4.9 million two-year agreement with Telecare Corporation for “Unarmed Mobile Mental Health Crisis Response Services” for individuals in crisis and their families who call 988 or the StarVista hotline at (650) 579-0350. We’ve seen suicide rates continue to climb which is a leading cause of death for children aged 10-14, young adults 20-34, and men, mostly white, 75 years and older. Now, the county will be able to provide unprecedented services, offering a new lifeline with in-person clinical support for those in crisis or feeling suicidal right where you live. This is 24/7 unarmed and compassionate approach meant to keep individuals out of our emergency rooms or jails and handled with care by trained clinicians.
---
The service will partially begin in May with one team during evening weekday hours before fully ramping up by August to five 24/7 teams and two on-call teams. It will be for people who do not need immediate hospitalization. Once 988 calls are screened by StarVista, the hotline will dispatch clinicians trained in crisis assessment, de-escalation and intervention. They will arrive in nondescript vehicles – no lights and sirens – around-the-clock, any day of the year with the goal of stabilizing situations and, if necessary, taking individuals or arranging transportation to the appropriate level of care. The County along with Telecare and StarVista will develop an outreach campaign to promote awareness of the hotline number and the service.
---
| **Hasty CPUC decision on Waymo is shocking** On Friday, March 1 the CPUC’s Consumer Protection and Enforcement Division (CPED) announced it will allow Waymo to operate in San Mateo and Los Angeles counties after it suspended its permit for up to 120 days Feb. 1 because of objections both counties made due to a lack of meaningful engagement to address public safety concerns. I thought the CPUC gave us 120 days to sit down with Waymo and discuss our concerns here in San Mateo County. I’m confused and a bit suspicious that the CPUC took only 11 days to change its mind on the suspension. I find this to be egregious and disingenuous. We have had no talks to address our concerns and it says to me that neither Waymo nor the CPUC care about local concerns over the public safety of our residents. This is why we need SB 915 The Autonomous Vehicle Service Deployment and Data Transparency Act by state Sen. Dave Cortese to pass in the Legislature. We need some local control over how robotaxis operate in the county because we know our roads and highways the best. We do not want to see the calamities that AVs have caused in San Francisco, including when a Waymo struck a bicyclist. In fact, robotaxis have caused all kinds of disastrous situations to the first responders in San Francisco including blocking the path of emergency vehicles responding to the scene of a mass shooting and entering an active fire scene, then parking on top of the fire hose. We want to avoid these dangerous scenarios in Silicon Valley and we need local control to do so. The county is now working with other jurisdictions who share are same concerns to determine what our next steps will be. Stay tuned!

See the ABC7 story on the issue here: [https://abc7news.com/waymo-robotaxi-san-mateo-county-la-expansion/14484113/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=f69ada6a31&e=c0babbc643)
---
---
| **Come celebrate the completion of Broadmoor’s Safe Routes to Schools project** The Broadmoor Safe Routes to School Pedestrian Improvements Project has completed and you are invited to join me for a ribbon cutting 10:30 a.m., Wednesday March 27 at the student drop off location off Park Plaza Drive near 87th Street. The estimated construction cost for this Project is $1,655,330 which includes $1,300,000 in federal Quick-Strike Program funding which I helped secure as a Commissioner on the Metropolitan Transportation Commission. The project includes installing pavement striping along the outside edges of the travel lanes on 87th Street to help provide drivers with a narrower sense of the roadway width. It also includes modifications at the intersection of 87th Street and Larchmont/Stoneyford Drive that will include painted medians and a painted bulb-out area at the corner of 87th Street and Larchmont Drive. These intersection modifications are intended to provide for a narrower area/travel lane to encourage drivers to slow down. The project stretches from 87th Street and Southgate Avenue to Sullivan Avenue and South Park Plaza Drive from 87th Street to approximately Palmcrest Drive. The work in general terms includes a raised midblock crosswalk on South Park Plaza Drive near Garden Village Elementary School and intersection improvements at 87th Street at South Park Plaza Drive/Nimitz Drive and 87th Street at Village Lane/Washington Street. I’m excited to see this project coming to completion as I’ve advocated for the safety of children walking to Garden Village and the nearby Ben Franklin Intermediate School. Thanks to the San Mateo Public Works department for overseeing this project which will benefit the neighborhood for generations to come.
---
| **Daly City welcomes Family Connections** I was excited to welcome Family Connections to Daly City Monday, February 12 at Susan B. Anthony Elementary School and cut the ribbon at its new family resources hub which offers free high-quality services in early childhood education, mental health, and family support for parents with children up to age 5. For 31 years, Family Connections has provided support through early learning classes, parent education and workshops, and mental health services in Redwood City and East Palo Alto. Through a partnership with the Jefferson Elementary School District, Family Connections is opening a site where families can access a variety of culturally authentic programming and services tailored to their unique needs. Family Connections helps families and children navigate toxic stress, food insecurity, the exorbitant cost of housing, which is all compounded by low wages. Recently, San Mateo County declared loneliness a public health crisis and Family Connections will help children and families find those deep connections that may have been lost during the pandemic. As a father of a 6-year-old, I can tell you that the more time I spend with my son reading, playing sports, or just hanging out and talking – the more confident and engaged he is. Early childhood education is so critical for social development. Its holistic approach of offering both early learning programming as well as home visiting and mental health services sets the foundation for the transformative change that happens at Family Connections every day. Family Connections improves parental involvement in a child’s education and is associated with higher self-esteem, better attendance, homework completion and higher graduation rates.
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=fd15eb1cf3&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org)
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=881bfdf3c1&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=58e1ce57fd&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=93b01c171b&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 **Interns wanted to join our team **

We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=daf2396208&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org) In friendship,
David J. Canepa
---
|
---
|
---
|

Supervisor David Canepa1618 Sullivan497Daly City, CA 94015
[Add us to your address book](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/vcard?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96)

Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/profile?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&e=c0babbc643&c=a0f63eb630) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=ea541c4b96&t=b&e=c0babbc643&c=a0f63eb630).

| | | **Support Quality Education in Washington 's 8th****!**
---

Dear Peter,
As parents, educators, and community members across Washington's 8th District, we know the importance of quality education. It's the foundation of our children's success, the backbone of our workforce, and the driving force behind a thriving community.
Our public schools are supposed to be places where all children can learn and grow, regardless of their background or beliefs. Unfortunately, they have become increasingly politicized, with agendas and ideologies taking priority over education.
This is unacceptable. We need to reclaim our schools and ensure they are focused on providing a quality education free from partisan influence.

---
| | | |
---
|
Would you consider making a contribution to help us:

* Oppose the politicization of curriculum and demand focus on core subjects.
* Protect parental rights to be involved in their children's education.
* Focus on education, not indoctrination into specific ideologies.

---

Together, we can reclaim our schools and ensure every child receives the quality education they deserve.

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

name: Katie Porter
subject: Last night’s results
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Thank you, thank you – from the bottom of my heart.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38780%2E3422442%2E7mvQWN)
Derek,
Last night didn’t go the way we hoped, and we came up short.
I want to thank each and every one of you for the support you have shown over the years. I never even considered running for office until Trump was elected. To me, that was for people who were more polished – who had more perfect lives. People of a certain pedigree.
But someone close to me said, “as a woman, if you wait your turn, you won’t get one.”
And what I found out over the last 6 years is that by and large it's true—there aren't a lot of people in Congress who are single moms; there aren’t many of us who live paycheck to paycheck; who go to the grocery store and understand how much a pack of bologna costs.
**Americans are hungry for leaders who break the mold.** We want honest leaders who are willing to call things like they see them. We want elected officials who will deliver truth to power and exact real accountability from big corporations and government bureaucrats. We want leaders who demand better from both parties – who want PROGRESS, not partisanship. Leaders whose bottom line is people, not profits.
That's why WE were able to turn heads in this campaign and make the people in power listen.
Let's be honest: I think all of us can agree, our government isn't working well for us.
**So many of those in power are too interested in helping other powerful people than paying attention to the needs of everyday people.** They are more interested in BEING an elected official than actually DOING anything to fix the problems everyday people face.
It's why billionaires fought so hard to keep me out of the Senate.
Special interests and the ultra wealthy like politics as it is today because they control the politicians. **And, like we’ve seen in this campaign, they spend millions to defeat someone who will dilute their influence and disrupt the status quo.** Because of you, we had the establishment running scared – withstanding 3 to 1 in TV spending, an onslaught of billionaires spending millions peddling lies, and our opponents spending more to boost the Republican than promoting his own campaign.
I've met so many people over the course of this race who tell me that they feel like their voices aren’t being heard by those who have the power. I’ll never stop fighting for all of those people.
Thank you, thank you – from the bottom of my heart.
Katie Porter

Tonight, I’ll take the stage for the first Democratic debate on live television.

This is a critical opportunity to discuss PA-10’s most pressing issues and speak directly to voters about how my lifetime of crisis-tested public service makes me uniquely qualified to represent our community in Congress.

I’m running to strengthen our democracy so that it works for all of us, but I can’t do it alone. **Let’s make our government of, by, and for the people, not high-dollar donors and $pecial interests.**

[We need a strong volunteer team to spread our message district-wide – will you sign up here to join us?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80457051/459392534/-104131788?source=RC_EM_EN_WL_240306_1_1&refcode2=0b5e7d0c-09dc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&contactdata=c70VH0qhEXv5UbprkUnxHXVS8nRLDTb5YjHBghPWN7jyZf7tHq3EKZboMHIQkute&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjVlN2QwYy0wOWRjLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QtbldFMId4Zb7fH9uwJHQGPeptf55CkWk8oB-de_g_Y=&emci=95466ea9-f1db-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=0b5e7d0c-09dc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=24669367) | | **[VOLUNTEER](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80457053/459392550/-104131788?source=RC_EM_EN_WL_240306_1_1&refcode2=0b5e7d0c-09dc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&contactdata=c70VH0qhEXv5UbprkUnxHXVS8nRLDTb5YjHBghPWN7jyZf7tHq3EKZboMHIQkute&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjVlN2QwYy0wOWRjLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QtbldFMId4Zb7fH9uwJHQGPeptf55CkWk8oB-de_g_Y=&emci=95466ea9-f1db-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=0b5e7d0c-09dc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=24669367)**

I look forward to outlining my vision for the future of our district on the debate stage. I’m confident that our message will resonate strongly with voters of all walks of life across PA-10.

Whether it is reproductive freedom, reducing gun violence, protecting Social Security and Medicare, guaranteeing a healthy climate for future generations, or more – we know there is a lot at stake in this race.

With our primary election just around the corner, this debate is critical for swaying undecided voters and shaping the dynamic of this race. That’s why we must be ready for anything tonight, especially as we look ahead to April 23.

The real race begins right now, and it's going to be a tough fight. But don't worry – I've been an underdog my whole life. I know what it takes to beat the odds and win a tough fight.
I'm a 4th generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom who sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. I never knew my dad but thanks to my community of teachers, coaches and counselors at the YMCA, who helped my mom, aunt and uncle raise me, I had the opportunity to chase my version of the American Dream.
Without them, I never would've made it to the NFL, gone to law school, become a civil rights lawyer, served in the Obama Administration, or run against a 22-year GOP incumbent and won, becoming the first Democrat to ever represent TX-32 in Congress.
**And thanks to them, I am where I am today: the official Democratic nominee who has the chance to become Texas’ first Black Senator.** The chance to finally defeat Ted Cruz and give Texans the committed leadership we deserve.
With experts calling Ted Cruz the most vulnerable GOP senator in the country and two polls showing us TIED, the only thing that could hold us back is resources.

body:
Right now, we’re seeing the erosion of women's reproductive rights across our nation, a step backward of nearly half a century.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80457557/459393965/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-03-06_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2VmYjEzMmEtMGJkYy1lZTExLTg1ZmItMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PZ27CxYKOLUMnRxtRLNFztK-v9aBQGNPKQPUXsbwIiU=)

| Peter,

This March, we celebrate Women’s History Month. During this month, I reflect on my gratitude for the women who came before me. As the first woman to ever hold my seat in Congress, I have a deep respect for the trailblazers who advocated for equal rights and opportunity and paved the way for future leaders.

While we've made remarkable progress over the years - from a record number of women elected to Congress to the historic election of the first female Vice President of the United States - there remains much more work to be done.

Right now, we’re seeing the erosion of women's reproductive rights across our nation, a step backward of nearly half a century. Never did I imagine my daughters growing up in a country where their bodily autonomy would be more restricted than mine.

Heartbreaking stories of women in dire need of medical care forced to travel great distances are all too common. Now, in Alabama, extremists have taken it further by imposing restrictions on family planning and breaking the hearts of families who had wanted to grow their families through IVF.

But in states across the country, voters are having a chance to make their voices heard. In states like Kansas and Ohio, voters have codified access to abortion into their state Constitutions. Voters are showing their fellow Americans that extreme politicians are out of touch with the American people, and the vast majority of individuals agree that women should be able to make their own choices without interference from the government.

Virginia stands as one of the few states in the South without restrictions on reproductive healthcare since the _Dobbs_ decision. As Governor, Virginia will not go backward.

clean_body: Right now, we’re seeing the erosion of women's reproductive rights across our nation, a step backward of nearly half a century. | = | Peter, This March, we celebrate Women’s History Month. During this month, I reflect on my gratitude for the women who came before me. As the first woman to ever hold my seat in Congress, I have a deep respect for the trailblazers who advocated for equal rights and opportunity and paved the way for future leaders. While we've made remarkable progress over the years - from a record number of women elected to Congress to the historic election of the first female Vice President of the United States - there remains much more work to be done. Right now, we’re seeing the erosion of women's reproductive rights across our nation, a step backward of nearly half a century. Never did I imagine my daughters growing up in a country where their bodily autonomy would be more restricted than mine. Heartbreaking stories of women in dire need of medical care forced to travel great distances are all too common. Now, in Alabama, extremists have taken it further by imposing restrictions on family planning and breaking the hearts of families who had wanted to grow their families through IVF. But in states across the country, voters are having a chance to make their voices heard. In states like Kansas and Ohio, voters have codified access to abortion into their state Constitutions. Voters are showing their fellow Americans that extreme politicians are out of touch with the American people, and the vast majority of individuals agree that women should be able to make their own choices without interference from the government. Virginia stands as one of the few states in the South without restrictions on reproductive healthcare since the Dobbs decision. As Governor, Virginia will not go backward. = | = Thank you, Abigail * | | = Paid for by Spanberger for Governor Spanberger for Governor P.O. I know you’re with me in this fight, and I’ll keep doing everything I can to pass the Freedom to Vote Act, take Vote by Mail nationwide, and make sure all Americans can have their voices heard in our democracy.

| | **Oregon had one of the highest turnout rates for youth voters in the country in 2022.** That's fantastic! One of the biggest reasons for that is Vote by Mail. It makes voting more accessible and empowers young voters to make their voices heard. Oregonians have been voting by mail for over 20 years, and because of it, we consistently have some of the highest rates of voter participation in the country. It's safe, secure, and leaves a paper trail – and there's no waiting in line to cast a ballot. Vote by Mail needs to be the law of the land, and when we pass the Freedom to Vote Act, it will be. I championed the Freedom to Vote Act to improve access to the ballot box for Americans, advance commonsense federal election standards and campaign finance reforms, and protect our democracy. Voting is a right and should be accessible and easy for all. The ballot box is the beating heart of our democracy, yet Americans continue to face an onslaught of voter suppression efforts by extremist Republicans that make it harder to vote or intentionally disenfranchise certain groups of voters. Democracy doesn't exist unless every eligible voter can vote and have their vote counted, and Vote by Mail will make it easier to do that. Vote by Mail is a democracy issue, not a political issue. We should embrace this safe, convenient way of allowing as many people as possible to vote. I know you're with me in this fight, and I'll keep doing everything I can to pass the Freedom to Vote Act, take Vote by Mail nationwide, and make sure all Americans can have their voices heard in our democracy. The ballot box is our only shot at defeating Donald Trump |
---
_Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80457862/459394922/-1590518309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZjNlNzA4Yi0wY2RjLWVlMTEtODVmYi0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=F7a32qm8-QVqyOVdXYMp7xrZJ9rCWjPbJuqMwX6KPVw=&emci=2964f7af-2cdb-ee11-85f9-002248223197&emdi=df3e708b-0cdc-ee11-85fb-002248223794&ceid=7878003)
Friend, Last fall, Eric testified in the Colorado Supreme Court case to bar Donald Trump from qualifying on the ballot, under the insurrection clause of the 14th Amendment. Since then, a handful of other states also moved to remove Trump’s name from the 2024 ballot. I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.**

Dear Peter,
The massive train wreck in East Palestine Ohio last year was, and remains, an environmental disaster of epic proportions.
4,800 American citizens were evacuated from their homes during an EPA conducted “controlled burn” of 20 or so railroad cars that contained toxic materials.
Many of those residents reported headaches and rashes after the derailment. But as more time passes, several appear to be developing cancer, many more are forced to import bottled drinking water.
And to date, no one in the Biden Administration has paid more than lip service about it.
Bottom line: the people living in East Palestine had their lives turned upside down—their homes, their neighborhoods, their entire way of life.
This is the kind of national emergency that should bring together the nation to help. This is a situation that should break down barriers between Republicans, Democrats and Independents.
This is about how we take care of our own—how we solve problems and meet real needs.
Yet for most residents, they feel abandoned...completely forgotten.
RFK Jr. had the opportunity to meet many of the people living in East Palestine, and so many hard-working middle-class families expressed frustration at what they say is a lack of answers from the railroad company and the government whose job it is to protect them.
The people living in East Palestine had their lives shattered, and to date they have not recovered. ... _And then they read that the CEO of the railroad just received a $3.6 million raise_.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/give-east-palestine?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=east_pal2_3_6_24_nd3b&n=3)
As your President, RFK Jr. will make it his top priority to take better care of each other, and reform government institutions that are failing to do that year in and year out.
That’s one reason why Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. is running for President: to hold officials in government accountable, to rebuild trust and transparency in the institutions that are supposed to assist and protect us during tragedies like East Palestine.
RFK Jr.’s experience and his commitment to the families in crisis _will not stop_ when he becomes President.
RFK Jr.’s experience and his commitment to taking on corporations and government entities that ignore the law and fail to do their jobs _will not stop_ when he becomes President.
[And with your commitment to put him on the ballot, there is no stopping him from becoming our next President.](https://www.kennedy24.com/give-east-palestine?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=east_pal2_3_6_24_nd3b&n=4)
