clean_body: 4,800 American citizens were evacuated from their homes. | | | | | Dear Peter, The massive train wreck in East Palestine Ohio last year was, and remains, an environmental disaster of epic proportions. 4,800 American citizens were evacuated from their homes during an EPA conducted “controlled burn” of 20 or so railroad cars that contained toxic materials. Many of those residents reported headaches and rashes after the derailment. But as more time passes, several appear to be developing cancer, many more are forced to import bottled drinking water. And to date, no one in the Biden Administration has paid more than lip service about it. Bottom line: the people living in East Palestine had their lives turned upside down—their homes, their neighborhoods, their entire way of life. This is the kind of national emergency that should bring together the nation to help. This is a situation that should break down barriers between Republicans, Democrats and Independents. This is about how we take care of our own—how we solve problems and meet real needs. Yet for most residents, they feel abandoned...completely forgotten. RFK Jr. had the opportunity to meet many of the people living in East Palestine, and so many hard-working middle-class families expressed frustration at what they say is a lack of answers from the railroad company and the government whose job it is to protect them. The people living in East Palestine had their lives shattered, and to date they have not recovered. ... And then they read that the CEO of the railroad just received a $3.6 million raise. As your President, RFK Jr. will make it his top priority to take better care of each other, and reform government institutions that are failing to do that year in and year out. That’s one reason why Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. is running for President: to hold officials in government accountable, to rebuild trust and transparency in the institutions that are supposed to assist and protect us during tragedies like East Palestine. RFK Jr.’s experience and his commitment to the families in crisis will not stop when he becomes President. RFK Jr.’s experience and his commitment to taking on corporations and government entities that ignore the law and fail to do their jobs will not stop when he becomes President. Please give now to support our effort to put RFK Jr. on the ballot in November and into the White House in January. Team Kennedy | to put a Kennedy back in the White House — Elect Robert F. name: Jirair Ratevosian
subject: I appreciate you, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Jirair Ratevosian for Congress
body:
Hi there, Peter.

When I first decided to run for Congress, I knew it was not going to be easy. After all, running a campaign can be expensive and exhausting. But I knew that no matter the outcome, it would all be worth it. And Peter, I couldn’t have been more right.

The diverse community that we’ve mobilized over the past few months has exceeded my every expectation. I’ve met Angelenos from all walks of life and listened to them share their stories, struggles, and wins. We attended parades, debates, rallies, and community events. We knocked doors, made phone calls, and texted voters. We spoke with thousands of voters across the city, and I am so grateful for every single conversation and what it taught me about the amazing city we call home.

Although we don't see a path to victory with 61% of the votes currently counted, I could not be prouder of how we ran this campaign. From being the first candidate to call for a ceasefire to standing up for the rights of all LGBTQ people, I’m proud of the values that this campaign stuck to even when the going got tough.

I’m also proud of the important representation we brought to all communities that call CA-30 home, including Armenian Americans. I started this campaign because right now a large portion of our representatives on Capitol Hill don’t reflect the diversity that I grew up with in Los Angeles which taught me important lessons and made me who I am today. I'm still going to be fighting for representation, equity, peace and justice for all communities.

So while the outcome might not have been what we had hoped for, I couldn’t be more thankful. Thank you to every person who volunteered, donated, or supported from afar. I appreciate every single one of you.

Sincerely,
Jirair

**Caren Fitzpatrick** is former Atlantic County Commissioner and last year’s Democratic candidate for State Senate in LD-2. With the future of the South Jersey economy on the line this election, she believes I’m the right man to take on this issue saying, “We believe in promoting Democratic values, driving economic growth, and securing a better and more affordable future for South Jersey.”
**Hector Tavarez** was an Egg Harbor Township Police Captain for over 25 years. He continues to serve the South Jersey community as the Executive Director of Police Activities League of Egg Harbor Township and Atlantic County. He was also one of our Atlantic County Commissioner candidates last year. His passion for the welfare of the children of South Jersey is unmatched. I believe in Hector’s mission, and I am ready to fight for our children in Congress.
**Anthony Angelozzi** is a U.S. History teacher at Hammonton High School and the Hammonton Municipal Chair and State Assembly candidate in LD-8. He dedicates his life to making South Jersey a better place for everyone, and he knows Van Drew does not have our interests at heart. In his own words: “Joe is a model candidate who will run the type of campaign that is necessary to unseat Jeff Van Drew.”
**Eric Scheffler** is the former Sheriff of Atlantic County. He has dedicated his career to advancing the professional development education for law enforcement officers all over New Jersey. He works tirelessly to educate our police officers and keep our community safe. I’m honored he is choosing to endorse me.
I’m honored by these endorsements, Peter. But the most important endorsement that I’m looking for, is the one from the voters of NJ-02. My team is working to get the word out about our campaign’s momentum, but we can’t reach undecided voters without grassroots support.

Peter ? this is bad ? really bad. We've just received word that a major right-wing Super PAC has dropped $5 million into the Arizona Senate race, where Senator Mark Kelly is up against venture capital executive Blake Masters.

Mark Kelly is an environmental champion who just helped secure the most significant climate investment in history. Blake Masters is a climate change denier who's backed by white supremacists.

This move follows a poll that puts the race within two points. Masters' political backers see a window to swing this Senate race, and they've jumped on it. What's more: the same Super PAC has spent millions on the Senate race in Georgia for Herschel Walker to defeat Senator Raphael Warnock.

Peter: Bottom line, we need your help. Environmental field operations are still underfunded, and a group of donors has put together an emergency match fund to triple every contribution. We have to move now or we could lose these races.

Your support is needed to secure important wins from climate candidates in November. TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT when you make a gift of any amount ? even $5 makes a difference >>> https://links.messages.lcv.

We have a goal to knock on 161,875 doors in Arizona, and a total of 1.17 million doors in critical swing states including Nevada, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. And we have digital ads running in support of dozens of pro-environmental candidates, which we'll continue leading up to the election.

Study after study shows that speaking with voters through field organizing is the best way to connect with voters about where candidates stand on critical issues ? and get them to turn out on Election Day.

We're scaling up on-the-ground canvassing operations, getting folks to sign commit-to-vote cards, and helping them sign up to vote by mail. And we're encouraging voters to commit to reminding three friends or family members to vote, a tactic called "Vote Tripling."

We're looking for fellow environmentalists like you, Peter, to help us continue our canvassing efforts and get pro-climate candidates elected in November. Can you chip in?

Every single vote counts. Please, pitch in ? ANY amount can really make a difference right now, even if it's just $5. This could be the difference between ensuring an environmental majority or setting us back indefinitely >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/-LXrB9V_

Help defeat Blake Masters and the other Big Oil candidates running this election cycle. Our future depends on it.

| **Congressman John Duarte Crushes Expectations, Secures Huge Victory **

_Results make Congressman Duarte a clear favorite for reelection_
---
| | **Ceres, CA** – With most votes counted in Tuesday’s primary election, Congressman John Duarte has secured a commanding victory over former Sacramento Legislator Adam Gray. Duarte, who defeated Gray by just 564 votes in the 2022 general election, currently leads Gray by more than eight percentage points. Duarte carried four of the five counties in the district, including a shocking win in Gray’s home County of Merced.

“These results prove that my record of working with both parties to make gas and groceries affordable, bring good-paying to the Valley, and fix our broken immigration system resonates with working families,” said Duarte. “They show that this November, voters will once again reject Adam Gray’s track record of extreme partisan politics.”

Duarte campaign consultant Duane Dichiara released the following statement:

“Once again, Congressman Duarte has beaten the expectations of political insiders, this time securing a dominant victory in one of the country’s ‘closest’ districts. These results reaffirm that Gavin Newsom and Joe Biden picked the wrong candidate in Adam Gray – Valley families rejected his track record of extreme politics and loyalty to party bosses for the third straight election, and they’ll make it four in November.”

“I am honored by the trust that Valley families have shown in this election, and I will keep working every day to earn that trust again this November,” said Duarte.
